task: known-item full-poem retrieval from a fixed 500-poem gallery using one deterministically selected couplet per query poem
gallery: all 500 retained poems; index vocabulary/IDF fits entire gallery. This is a different task from held-out poem classification; no claim of unseen-poem attribution.
development: 100 classification-validation poems used for retrieval development queries
test: 100 classification-test poems used only as retrieval query identities after this protocol. Classification results already viewed; retrieval is an additional predeclared analysis, not independent replication.
query: choose minimum SHA256 ASCII retrieval-query-v1|20261025|PoemId|CoupletIndex among actual two-verse source couplets; prepare canonical/shared-author-mask using unchanged poetry_core.py
tfidf: same shared TF-IDF/family settings as poetry_text_v0.2, fitted on full gallery; sparse cosine via L2-normalized vectors
ranking: descending cosine then ascending numeric poem ID; no hits if query vector empty or score<=0; substring hits ascending poem ID; no threshold tuned
noise: unchanged poetry_core.corrupt; nested source-letter corruption; same query for each retrieval method
metrics: MRR (full positive-score ranking; zero for no hit)
primary: char minus word Recall@1 at 5%, averaged over three query corruption seeds

bootstrap.scheme: 20 poems resampled within each author with replacement, same query/seed indices across methods
bootstrap.limits: conditional on fixed gallery, selected couplets and these corruption draws; no unseen-item inference

test_gate: behavior tests, index/source/config hashes, development results, frozen test query identities, exclusive test marker
rights: local-only gallery and query text/index; output bundle contains IDs and metrics only
deferred: Real OCR/ASR evaluation needs installed engines and independently transcribed paired samples; adapter readiness is not modality performance.
